text:
[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
number - number.floor
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma floor_properties
(number: Rat)
: number > 0 →
0 ≤ number - number.floor ∧
number.floor + (number - number.floor) = number :=
begin
  intros h_pos,
  unfold Rat.floor,
  rw [Rat.floor_eq_of_pos],
  use number - number.floor,
  split,
  { rw [Rat.sub_le_self_of_pos h_pos], },
  { rw [Rat.add_sub_cancel], },
end
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation number
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  intros h_pos
  have h_0_le_res: 0 ≤ result := by
    simp [Rat.sub_le_self_of_pos h_pos]
  have h_res_lt_1: result < 1 := by
    simp [Rat.sub_lt_one_of_pos h_pos]
  have h_num_floor_res_eq_num: number.floor + result = number := by
    simp [Rat.sub_add_cancel]
  exact And.intro h_0_le_res h_res_lt_1 h_num_floor_res_eq_num
[END]
